title: Broken Postgres: Missing Index
description: Customers are complaining about slow order lookups. The orders-service is timing out and the load generator is reporting 300-600ms latencies. Find the bottleneck and restore latency below 50ms.

problemStatement.incident: Order lookups are slow under modest traffic.
problemStatement.situation: A small e-commerce shop is seeing /orders/<user_id> requests take 300-600ms. The orders-service is healthy and Postgres is up. Your job: identify why and bring p50 latency below 50ms.
tasks: Open psql against the postgres container and inspect the schema of the `orders` table.
Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE on `SELECT ... FROM orders WHERE user_id = $1` to identify the access pattern.
Create the appropriate index so that lookups by user_id no longer perform a sequential scan.
Verify the metrics panel shows sustained latency < 50ms (recovery threshold).
End the session to lock in your score.
dbAccess: docker compose exec postgres psql -U appuser -d shop
user: appuser  password: apppass  database: shop
problemStatement.scoring: Base 100 - 2 per elapsed minute + 30 if recovered + 10 per validation step passed.
